commits.message: fix: Validate layout broadcasts from the current leader

feat: start the photo table, replacing Polywogs

I changed my mind about the project. Removes the Polywogs code and adds the working photo-table spike: devices join screens into one table, share photos as prints, and take the ones they want, directly over WebRTC or through an end-to-end encrypted relay. Pages now publishes web/ as a static site.
